title: Trustpilot Reviews Scraper: Public Reviews & Ratings
description: Public Trustpilot reviews and company rating summaries. $0.001 per saved review plus the small Actor-start charge. The scheduled company-check fee was canceled. Check the live Pricing tab before running.

companyNames.title: Company Domains or Trustpilot Slugs
companyNames.description: Company domains or Trustpilot review slugs, for example "nike.com". Duplicate company targets are removed before scraping.

companyUrls.title: Trustpilot Company URLs
companyUrls.description: Full Trustpilot company review URLs, for example "https://www.trustpilot.com/review/nike.com".

maxReviewsPerCompany.title: Max Reviews Per Company
maxReviewsPerCompany.description: Maximum reviews to save per company. At 1 GB, one saved review currently costs $0.00105 and will cost $0.00130 after the scheduled Actor Start change on 24 October 2026. Check the live Pricing tab. Set 0 for all available pages, subject to safety limits.

sortBy.title: Sort Reviews By
sortBy.description: How to order reviews on each company page. Lowest rated applies a one-star filter unless another rating filter is selected.

filterByRating.title: Filter By Star Rating
filterByRating.description: Only save reviews with this star rating. Choose "All Ratings" for no explicit rating filter.

verifiedOnly.title: Verified Reviews Only
verifiedOnly.description: If enabled, only reviews marked verified by Trustpilot are saved to the dataset.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings for browser requests. Direct access is the default to control cost. If your run is blocked, you can explicitly choose a proxy; the Actor never silently switches to Residential traffic.
